liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **RowJimmy** (2 reviews): Described as a dreamy, killer version; Reviewer recalls Garcia apparently playing flute during it; a friend could not see the flute [7][12]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Called solid; Black Peter was also good [7]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Plods at an unusual tempo, with drummers conspicuous and distracting [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **More Space**: back after 445 archived shows (2122 days); rare: 4 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-05-28.sbd.mrod.28467.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 149 min; rated 2.56/5 by 33 [1]. Said about its sound: Decent recording, but wind in the huge open space made capturing an audience source difficult [13]
- **gd95-05-28.schoeps.9992.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 2.08/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound was manipulated during the shows, adding a breezy, floating quality to the audience recording [6]
- **gd1995-05-28.aud.russjcan.92041.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 156 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1995-05-28.schoeps.unknown.larson.33569.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Sunny, breezy day; Chuck Berry stopped about 45 seconds into Promised Land, leaving the crowd puzzled and embarrassed [6]
- Chuck Berry played about 15 songs in 30 minutes; the reviewer wished Weir or Garcia had joined him [7]
- Reviewer attended and says Garcia sang only five songs; Chuck Berry was somewhat entertaining [10]
- Reviewer says Garcia sang five songs; tempos wander in places, but there are sweet spots [11]
- Reviewer disagrees that Garcia did well on his five songs, calling them abysmal [15]
- First set ended with Let It Grow at 61 minutes; second set ran 84 minutes, with Box Of Rain as encore [1]
- Considered a big drop in quality from the Seattle shows two days earlier [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-05-28.sbd.mrod.28467.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sbd > C (x?) > CD > EAC > SHN [1]. Also: Source chain listed as soundboard, to cassette (generation unknown), to CD, then EAC extraction, then SHN [1]
- **gd95-05-28.schoeps.9992.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B. and Chris L.; source: Audience: Schoeps MK21's [3]
- **gd1995-05-28.aud.russjcan.92041.flac16**: taped by Russjcan; transferred by Russjcan; source: Hat mounted Realistic PZM's with Sony WMD6-C Sony Metal SR 100 No nr 1st set Maxell MX 100 No nr 2nd set 50 feet away Dead Center [2]
- **gd1995-05-28.schoeps.unknown.larson.33569.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: Af:D4 Schoeps CMC + MK21>DAT(48kHz) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Portland Meadows - May 28, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/may-28-1995) [18]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Portland Meadows - May 28, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/may-28-1995) [19]
- Poster by gocollect.com: [MXP-89.3 Grateful Dead Portland Meadows 1995 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/mxp-89-3-grateful-dead-portland-meadows-1995) [20]
